lines: The Spring 2027 RSO Recognition process is now open on EngageSC for new RSOs
and for organizations re-establishing after a lapse in recognition this year.
If you need accessibility accommodations or have questions about the process,
please contact Campus Activities at stuacts@usc.edu and allow three days.
November 22 at 11:59pm: Application closes. You must submit the form on time.
December 1: Deadline for advisors to submit their requirements on EngageSC.
Officers must finish their trainings before the application can be approved.
Late applications are not accepted, and a lapsed club waits for next spring.
